source.upstreamIdentifier: RAH Room ledger and Room-first architecture

extraction.method: Curated index of RAH-owned protocol boundaries that adapt Raft-visible behavior to the local-first daemon.

canonicalTaskSemantics.owner: The daemon owns Task lifecycle and persists one canonical state; visible workflow columns are projections.
canonicalTaskSemantics.boundary: Provider turn lifecycle, assistant prose, and page-local state cannot complete a Task.

boundedRoomHistory.owner: The daemon exposes revision-keyed, cursor-bounded Room history; the browser owns only an in-memory projection.
boundedRoomHistory.boundary: No transcript cache in localStorage or IndexedDB becomes conversation truth.

canonicalCollaborationFlow.owner: Room, Task, Review, Activation, and RunAttempt have distinct daemon owners and typed transitions.
canonicalCollaborationFlow.boundary: Raft-visible workflow is adopted without importing a simulated reference-project state machine.

roomSystemNotifications.owner: The durable Human Inbox and typed Room links determine notification candidates; browser permission and local preference determine presentation.
roomSystemNotifications.boundary: A browser visual test cannot establish iOS or private Raft server parity.

exactPresentationAcknowledgement.owner: The daemon owns exact Inbox acknowledgement; the focused Web projection may request it only for the exact entity currently presented at the canonical Room head.
exactPresentationAcknowledgement.boundary: Chat acknowledges visible messages only at the latest edge. Tasks acknowledges Task/Review attention only when the exact card intersects at least 50% of its board scroll container; mounted but horizontally or vertically offscreen cards remain pending. Members, background documents, stale heads, and historical message windows never acknowledge.
exactPresentationAcknowledgement.evidence: The browser suite proves pending-to-acknowledged for a focused typed Task deep link, proves a 390px horizontally offscreen Task remains pending until scrolled into view, and proves unseen messages remain pending on Members, Tasks, and historical Chat views.
